issues.description: The problem statement and tests expect public getters for all attributes (e.g., getLectureName(), getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), but the reference solution declares some getters as private (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This visibility mismatch can confuse students and cause discrepancies when comparing their implementations against the provided solution or when tests expect public access.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all attributes public in the reference solution (change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public) so their visibility matches the problem description and expected tests.
